pages.text: “Wild ferns, refreshing and invigorating—the bitterness fades, leaving behind the joy of speed.”$(br2)Fern Tea is a wild, earthy drink made by blending fern leaves, sugar, and honey. It restores a small amount of hunger and often grants a Speed boost, though there is a slight chance of mild poisoning.

$(br2)$(br)Fern Tea is crafted by $(br)mixing fern leaves with sugar and honey.$(br)It is a great choice for travelers, allowing them to move quickly while also restoring some hunger, but beware of potential side effects.

Upon drinking Fern Tea, travelers restore some hunger and have a high chance of receiving a Speed boost, though there is a small chance of mild poisoning.$(br)This tea is ideal for exploration and running, but should be consumed with caution.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
